_notes.title: The name at the top of the page and in the browser tab.
_notes.players: The names shown at each side of the board. Write "computer" for a side to have the computer play it.
_notes.strength: The computer's level, 1 to 4. Level 4 thinks for up to two seconds a move.
_notes.theme: The board: glass-noir (black lacquer), glass-amber (walnut and amber glass), or ice (white marble and blue glass).
_notes.clock: none, 5+0, 10+0, or 15+10 (fifteen minutes and ten seconds added after each move).
_notes.sound: true for the glass set-down, capture, and check sounds; false for silence.
